_comment: Merge into a composed checkout's .claude/settings.json (folio-assistant, or any index that mounts cat-harness-tools at cat-harness-tools/). It runs the fast gates before an agent's `git push` and blocks the push on a red one; see scripts/pre-push-gates.ts and bean cat-tools-pp9g. For cat-harness-tools checked out on its own, the path is scripts/pre-push-gates.ts.
